2607.16997.title: PriorProof: A Point-in-Time Measure of Technique Novelty for Formal Proofs
2607.16997.paper_summary: Mathematicians distinguish proofs that explain, simplify, or introduce a nonstandard route, but these judgments are difficult to operationalize. We study a deliberately narrower construct: time-relative proof-route nonstandardness in formal mathematics. For a Lean theorem, PriorProof extracts the dependency footprint of its elaborated proof term and scores the weighted surprisal of that footprint under a retrieval-conditioned, hierarchically smoothed prior built only from an earlier quarterly snapshot of Mathlib. The method requires no hand-built technique ontology and no human labels: statement retrieval is learned from proof-derived contrastive pairs, while the scored object is read mechanically from proof terms. In a blinded topology study, 100 presentations collapse to 76 distinct underlying pairs: 12 canonical contrasts shown three times for consistency screening and 64 distinct stratified pairs. Against the majority of three retained domain raters, PriorProof agrees on 53/76 pairs (69.7%, Wilson 95% CI 58.7-78.9%), including 11/12 canonical pairs (91.7%, 64.6-98.5%) and 42/64 stratified pairs (65.6%, 53.4-76.1%). Score-gap quartiles are nonmonotone after repeat collapse; the endpoints are 12/19 (63.2%, 41.0-80.9%) in the smallest-gap bin and 16/19 (84.2%, 62.4-94.5%) in the largest, supporting an endpoint-calibration tendency rather than a resolved staircase. The best language-model condition agrees on 60/76 pairs (78.9%, 68.5-86.6%); on paired outcomes, PriorProof alone is correct on 8 pairs and the model alone on 15 (exact two-sided McNemar p = 0.210), so the difference is not established at this sample size. We therefore present PriorProof not as a replacement for expert or model judgment, but as a decomposable, time-anchored signal whose score gap provides an interpretable reliability indicator.
2607.16997.paper_summary_zh: 數學家區分解釋、簡化或引入非標準路徑的證明，但這些判斷難以操作化。我們研究一個故意狹窄的構造：正式數學中與時間相關的證明路徑非標準性。對於一個 Lean 定理，PriorProof 提取其詳細證明項的依賴足跡，並根據僅從之前一個季度的 Mathlib 快照構建的檢索條件、分層平滑的先驗，對該足跡進行加權驚訝度評分。該方法不需要手工構建的技術本體，也不需要人類標籤：聲明檢索是從證明派生的對比對中學習的，而被評分的對象是從證明項中機械地讀取的。在一項盲測拓撲研究中，100 次展示合併為 76 個不同的潛在對：12 個經典對比顯示三次以進行一致性篩選，和 64 個不同的分層對。對於三位保留的領域評價者中的大多數，PriorProof 在 76 對中同意 53 對（69.7%，Wilson 95% CI 58.7-78.9%），包括 12/12 個經典對（91.7%，64.6-98.5%）和 42/64 個分層對（65.6%，53.4-76.1%）。在重複合併後，得分差距四分位數是非單調的；在最小差距區間的端點是 12/19（63.2%，41.0-80.9%），在最大差距區間的端點是 16/19（84.2%，62.4-94.5%），支持端點校準趨勢而非解決的階梯。最佳語言模型條件在 76 對中同意 60 對（78.9%，68.5-86.6%）；在配對結果中，PriorProof 單獨對 8 對是正確的，模型單獨對 15 對是正確的（精確雙側 McNemar p = 0.210），因此在這個樣本大小下，差異並未確立。因此，我們將 PriorProof 呈現為不是專家或模型判斷的替代品，而是一個可分解的、時間錨定的信號，其得分差距提供了一個可解釋的可靠性指標。
